description: This file defines the EventHubQueueCacheFactory class, which implements the IEventHubQueueCacheFactory interface. It is responsible for creating and configuring instances of EventHubQueueCache, including buffer pools, cache pressure monitors, and cache-specific configurations for Azure Event Hubs streaming.

classes.name: EventHubQueueCacheFactory
classes.description: Factory class to create and configure EventHubQueueCache instances with specific monitoring and pooling options.

methods.name: CreateCache
methods.description: Creates an EventHubQueueCache for a specific partition with configured buffer pool and pressure monitors.

methods.name: CreateBufferPool
methods.description: Configures and returns a buffer pool for the EventHubQueueCache, with optional override for customization.

methods.name: AddCachePressureMonitors
methods.description: Adds cache pressure monitors to the EventHubQueueCache based on the provided options.

methods.name: CreateCache (protected)
methods.description: Default creation of EventHubQueueCache, which can be overridden for additional customization.
